title: Webpack
description: A powerful module bundler for JavaScript applications.

data.text: Webpack is a static module bundler that builds a dependency graph of your application and bundles all modules into one or more bundles. It supports loaders for different file types and plugins for build optimization.

data.title: Basic Webpack Config
data.content: Configure webpack with entry, output, and a babel loader.

terms.definition: A transformation that preprocesses files (e.g., Babel for JS, CSS loader for styles).
An extension that performs custom build operations like code splitting or HTML generation.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Uses loaders to handle non-JS files
data.takeaway: Webpack is the most configurable bundler, powering complex build pipelines.
